gates.description: Hara owns a headless workspace.* state, event, view and effect contract.
gates.evidence: hara-lang/hara#383 introduced workspace.*, #384 synchronized runtime mirrors and conformance paths, and #385 restored the complete release/archive validation. The pinned Hara revision retains that boundary.

gates.description: Hara web-* packages remain product-neutral and include a neutral add-on lifecycle.
gates.evidence: hara-lang/hara-ui#9 merged at dd871a20e110f1775d3b6584d037fb48862ca7fc with green package tests and is pinned.

gates.description: Hodos Web connects HAL-shaped Workspace models to trusted packaged UI factories and responsive shell mechanics.
gates.evidence: greenways-ai/hodos#24 established trusted component and area hosts, #25 added prepared Preview documents, #26 added Editor, #27 REPL, #28 Value Inspector, #29 Problems, #30 Explorer and #31 Catalog. #32 adds the recursive responsive Workspace shell for area, split and empty nodes, accessible splitter geometry, compact surfaces, trusted component mounting and adopted-root restoration. Hara remains the source of manifest and Workspace semantics. The merged Hodos revision is pinned.

gates.description: Playground is the reference workspace.edn-driven Hodos shell consumer while retaining Hara runtime and application policy authority.
gates.evidence: hara-lang/hara-playground#29-#38 progressively mounted Preview, Editor, REPL, Value Inspector, Problems, Explorer and Catalog through Hodos. #39 replaced the active fixed desktop/mobile layout controller with the recursive Hodos shell, evaluated workspace.edn through Hara and preserved Playground product authority. #40 removed the inactive competing layout model/controller, made every featured sample a complete explicit workspace.edn project, and documented the delivered Hara → Playground → Hodos authority chain. The exact #40 revision passed all 203 Node tests, architecture/check scripts, production build, checksum-verified runtime installation, isolated Chromium Audio validation and the complete Supersonic manifest/browser workflow.

gates.description: Existing Hodos Worlds source, renderer and viewer contracts remain compatible during the broader reorganisation.
gates.evidence: The pinned Hodos revision keeps Core independent and retains replaceable source, renderer and viewer packages while adding Dev and Workspace shell components above them; the complete Hodos package, Worlds, demo and site gates passed.

gates.description: Greenways OS retains installation, keyring, consent and privileged capability authority outside Hodos.
gates.evidence: The pinned Greenways OS baseline verifies installed app identity and keeps raw key material out of application surfaces.

gates.description: A Hodos keyring connector requests typed operations without receiving credentials or private keys.
Supersonic is an optional Hodos Audio connector rather than an inseparable neutral Hara runtime feature.
gates.evidence: Tracked by greenways-ai/hodos#22 and the later Hara runtime profile split. The pinned Playground browser gate proves the current Supersonic project remains compatible while this ownership split is still pending.
